description: This file defines the LanguageAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing Language entities within an HRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations (create, get, update, delete), validation rules, and API documentation annotations. The class extends a base Endpoint and implements a CrudEndpoint, utilizing services and models for language management.

classes.name: LanguageAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for managing Language entities, including CRUD operations, validation, and documentation for the system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a specific Language record by ID, returning a resource result or throwing if not found.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single Language record.

methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Language records, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing Language records.

methods.description: Persists a Language entity after setting its name.
